allowed_use: Evidence that (1) the L2 replacement decision of the shared miss core (byte-capacity recency replacement at the 8 MiB nominal size) is correct for the grouped-MoE operand streams once the hardware execution order is known: replaying each configuration in its own measured per-CTA order reproduces the DRAM counters; (2) the co-resident weight-sharing loss is carried by execution order, specifically by a phase-locked versus desynchronised regime of CTA progress, and not by L2 request traffic, outstanding-miss pressure or reuse-protecting replacement; (3) in the phase-locked regime the co-progressing group is one CTA per AP (104), which is what the lock-step core replays.
forbidden_use: Any duration.  The per-CTA stamps are execution-order evidence inside this microbenchmark and must not price a Forward path.  No phase-spread statistic, sharer spread, offset range or regime label may be copied, fitted or interpolated into a predictor or the miss core: the regime is a dynamical outcome that the stamps observe and no launch-physical variable determines here.

instrument.counters: mcProfiler perf_exec --custom --per-kernel, host-global serial, one marker window per part
instrument.stamps: __builtin_mxc_get_realtime at k steps 0, S/4, S/2, 3S/4, S per CTA (twin binary, no profiler)

geometry.weight_layout: [E, K, N] column block, rows N*2 B apart

supporting_timing_probes.note: Timing-classified mechanism probes (reload latency hit/miss, global realtime).  Mechanism evidence only; no value may price a Forward path.

l2_random_pool_eviction.finding: A line one AP brought in hits for other APs (empty-pool reload ~500 ticks vs ~600-650 after eviction): the L2 is chip-shared.  Eviction of one target by N random lines is a smooth ramp, 0/16 up to 4 MiB, then 1, 5, 4, 8, 13, 12, 15 of 16 at 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12 MiB (earlier run: 5/7/9/11/15/16 of 16 at 6/7/8/9/10/12 MiB), consistent with a hashed set-associative recency cache of 8 MiB.

l2_recency_protection.finding: A 2-6 MiB hot set read once or twice before a target does not shrink the target survival against N new lines (at N=6 MiB: 8/24 evicted with no hot set, 2-7/24 with any hot set): replacement is recency-ordered, not reuse-protecting (RRIP-like insertion would evict the target first).

cta_dispatch_order.finding: CTAs start in near pid order (|start rank - pid| p50 14-33, p99 80-99 of 46080).  Doubling the work of the pid%8==0 class leaves that class starting a constant ~900 realtime units later at the 10/50/90% quantiles instead of falling progressively behind: dispatch is one global dynamic queue, not per-cluster queues bound by pid.

stream_sharing_step_stamps.finding: Every CTA passes through the same four AP arbitration tiers from youngest to oldest resident in both regimes (median per-step wall in the steady-state middle half: b_only 143/29/7/3.2 us, hot A + B 64-73/17/7.2/3.6 us, gather + B 30/14/8/4.2 us) and the median CTA life is similar (701/727/691 us).  In the phase-locked configurations the tiers are aligned across APs (slot rotation happens chip-wide at once, so consecutive pids land one per AP in the same tier); in gather + B the alignment is lost (CTA life p10/p90 698/1218 us), consecutive pids land on APs in different tiers and are promoted at different times.  The tier rates are a property of this code's instruction mix under the AP arbitration and are not transferable to another binary.

l2_stride_conflict.finding: One workgroup cycling 64-4096 lines at 8, 32, 128 and 45 KiB strides realises 1.00-1.09 passes of 8 (the 1.09 is the constant per-launch read): no set concentration at the power-of-two strides of the E8 W1 streams.

routed_production_address_probe.finding: With the dataset runner routing reconstructed exactly (deterministic heap top-k over tok_per_expert, moe_align_block_size ascending routes) and [E, N, K] weights read as BN rows of BK*2-byte half lines, all six kernel streams (three cases x W1/W2) are desynchronised (GSM sharer spread p50 27-80 steps).  Replaying each no-C run in its own measured order through the 8-MiB LRU reproduces the counter for four of six streams within 3 percent (E32 W1 10.67/11.06, W2 6.10/6.03, E128 W1 12.72/12.68, W2 4.29/4.42 GiB); E8 W1/W2 replay low (13.96/33.60, 14.54/17.57).  The same exact streams in lock-step wave-104 order give 2.2-7.3 GiB.  The replica magnitudes differ from the production kernels of the same cases (for example E32 W1 11.06 against 7.75 GiB read), consistent with code-shape dependence of the desynchronised phase distribution.
routed_production_address_probe.e8_single_stream_note: E8 W1 single streams exceed their measured-order replay even alone (B only 20.23 against 4.81 GiB, A only 2.37 against 0.066), while E32/E128 single streams replay within 7 percent.  Ruled out: power-of-two stride set concentration (l2_stride_conflict), DRAM saturation (146 GB/s), pending-miss merge (GSM sharer spread p50 5.2 us against 0.37 us miss latency, same as E32).  Unexplained.
